evidence.detail: The class implements ActionListener and its actionPerformed source is cast to javax.swing.Timer, which it always stops before clearing Launcher.r.
When the live ClientSidebarPanel exists and its loadout JComboBox popup is not visible, the listener repaints the sidebar panel before stopping the timer.
The class stores only its synthetic Launcher owner and touches only launcher/sidebar repaint state plus the one-shot Timer lifecycle.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the one-shot launcher timer action that repaints the side panel and clears the pending-refresh flag.
